title: Weird pattern in the ICLR papers I was assigned to review [D]
summary: I was assigned 3 ICLR papers to review. I generally consider myself a pretty nice reviewer but...all 3 of them are slop. Unfiltered Claude slop. The language is so awful it is almost impossible to read. Unfortunately, I imagine this is common among "top" conference submissions no
